title: Stored Credential
applicability: Applies to Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and Amex Segment 100 transactions that store or reuse a stored credential for merchant-initiated (MIT) or cardholder-initiated (CIT) recurring, installment, or unscheduled transactions.

businessRequirements.title: When storing a credential for the first time, Variable Information Table ID 32 Sub Table 08 shall carry Value 'I' (Initial), whether sent as a $0.00 Account Verification or an amount-due transaction.

A merchant-initiated recurring stored-credential transaction shall be identified as 'R', use Table ID 32 Sub Table 08 = 'C' (Subsequent), POS Entry Mode '10', and include Table ID 49 Sub Table 02 = 'M' (Merchant Initiated).

A merchant-initiated installment stored-credential transaction shall be identified as 'I', use Table ID 32 Sub Table 08 = 'C', POS Entry Mode '10', include Table ID 49 Sub Table 02 = 'M', and must not send CVV2 data.

A merchant-initiated unscheduled stored-credential transaction shall not be identified as Installment or Recurring, and shall include Table ID 49 Sub Table 02 = 'M', Table ID 32 Sub Table 08 = 'C', and POS Entry Mode '10'.

A cardholder-initiated recurring or installment stored-credential transaction shall use Table ID 32 Sub Table 08 = 'I' and Table ID 49 Sub Table 02 = 'C' (Cardholder Initiated) with the original POS Entry Mode on the initial transaction.
CVV2 data must not be sent for MIT recurring, MIT installment, or CIT recurring/installment stored-credential transactions.

The Visa/Amex Transaction ID and Discover Network Reference Number returned on the initial stored-credential authorization response shall be stored and included on all subsequent merchant-initiated transactions using that credential.

testCases.positive: Initial storage carries Sub Table 08 Value 'I'
MIT recurring/installment/unscheduled fields match the applicable pattern
CIT initial transaction carries 'C' indicator and original POS Entry Mode
negative: POS Entry Mode not preserved on initial transaction

testCases.positive: CVV2 absent on MIT/CIT recurring and installment transactions
negative: CVV2 present on a prohibited stored-credential transaction

testCases.positive: Subsequent transaction carries the stored Transaction ID/Network Reference Number
negative: Subsequent transaction omits or alters the stored reference
